DB9 to RJ45 Console Cable 1.8m/6ft – RS232 to RJ45 Serial Cable Compatible with Cisco Devices

This 1.8-meter (6-foot) DB9 to RJ45 console cable is designed for reliable and efficient connectivity between your computer’s serial port and network equipment console ports. It features a standard RS232 DB9 female connector on one end and an RJ45 male connector on the other, making it ideal for configuring and managing Cisco routers, switches, firewalls, and other networking devices.


Key Features:

  • 【Wide Compatibility】DB9 to RJ45 console management cable connects your PC laptop to Cisco router, switch, firewall, wireless device and other Serial based Cisco device. It also compatible with Juniper, NETGEAR, Ubiquity, LINKSYS, TP-Link, huawei, H3C, HP, 3com products.
  • Cisco console cable's cross reference is equivalent to Cisco Part Number 72-3383-01, CAB-CONSOLE-RJ45, CAB-CONSOLE, CAB-1700-CON=, CAB-1600-CAN=, ACS-2600ASYN=, CAB-ME-CON=, AIR-CONCAB1200=, 1401-01B7000
  • 【Easy to Use】It supports windows Mac OS, Luxin system, no need to install driver, plug and play.It communicates with terminals that have a DB9 port.*Please make sure it supports your device before ordering.*
  • 【Design and Quality】Flat cable design protect cord from tangling. 6 feet length cable roll, is a convenient distance to connect the computer and other devices. High-purity oxygen-free copper core, the thick signal transmission line ensures stable signal transmission and fast transmission speed.
  • 【Perfect Data Cable Replacement】The console cable is a replacement data cable for reprogramming and updating compatible equipment and devices; can possibly be used to configure other networking devices as well.
  • 【100% SATISFACTION SERVICE】If you have any question about our product, please feel free to contact us. We will take full responsibility for the product quality and try our best to solve your problem quickly and efficiently!
